svg.font-family: Apple SD Gothic Neo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: S2 Duotone — Phosphor (phosphor_flutter) + Material Symbols alt row
Duotone: 20% tint fill + 8/256 stroke. Read|Edit = book-open | pencil-simple-line. Bottom row = Material Symbols Rounded (fill), Apache-2.0, for comparison.
LIGHT · 24px GRID SHOWN AT 2x (48px) · violet = ⚡ only
DARK · 24px GRID SHOWN AT 2x (48px) · violet = ⚡ only
Glyphs: Phosphor (MIT) duotone; Material Symbols Rounded fill (Apache-2.0). New chat has no Phosphor equivalent: note-pencil (compose) substituted; Ask = chat-teardrop-text.
